subject: Re: Kickoff: DPOK fine-tuning for the image-gen stack
body:
Decision time, with LRB on May 14.

We go with option (a): kl_weight 0.03, the robust setting. Rationale: the Launch Review Board cares more about "no embarrassing failure modes" than peak side-by-side wins, and Tereza's drift examples on text-in-image prompts are exactly the kind of thing that gets a demo pulled. The measured win at 0.03 — +13% internal preference score, up from the base model, across the full prompt distribution — is still a clear story.

Option (b) doesn't die: Chiara will keep the per-cluster early-stopping branch alive as the Q3 path, funded under the scale-up line Alina secured.

Scope cut for this half: no reward-model refresh before the demo. Frozen reward model, frozen eval set, boring and defensible.

See everyone at the dry run Tuesday.

Ulla
